decisions.proposed_text: Do đã nhận Chỉ dẫn từ Legend khác nên không thể học Skill này
decisions.reason: Generic gameplay 技能 must use the canonical player-facing term Skill, not kỹ năng.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.skill.generic requires Skill and forbids Kỹ năng.

decisions.reason: Meaning, placeholder, and Vietnamese wording are preserved cleanly.

decisions.proposed_text: <color=#FF6D26>Hứng khởi Siêu Tuyệt Hảo</color> giúp không mắc <color=#2E85E6>「Migraine」</color>
decisions.reason: The quoted named Condition must use its established canonical Global name Migraine; tags and meaning are otherwise preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.condition.migraine.reference and condition.migraine.reference require Migraine and forbid Đau nửa đầu for the quoted Condition.

decisions.proposed_text: <color=#FF6D26>Lĩnh vực Thử thách</color> giúp không xuất hiện <color=#2E85E6>「Slacker」</color>
decisions.reason: The explicitly quoted negative Condition is the established player-facing Slacker Condition, not a literal Vietnamese calque; color tags are preserved.
The continuation indicator and direction marker are preserved with acceptable concise Vietnamese.
Concise UI wording preserves the acquisition-condition meaning without structural loss.
The effect-summary label is semantically correct and natural for UI use.
The confirmation question is faithful and natural; CM is preserved as the source label.
The navigation command is accurate and concise.
The start-of-training announcement preserves meaning and tone cleanly.
The acquired-insights list label is semantically faithful and consistent with the surrounding Legend UI.
The insights-list label is clear and consistent with adjacent UI labels.
The acquired-insight status text is faithful and concise.
The appearance-rate increase label is accurate and natural.
The Guide label is consistent with adjacent Legend terminology and has no structural issue.
